question: What did the company of the prophets at Bethel and Jericho already know?
options: That the LORD was going to take Elijah away that day
That Elijah would divide the Jordan
That bears would come out of the woods
explanation: The prophets asked Elisha if he knew the LORD was going to take his master from him that day, and Elisha said, 'Yes, I know, so be quiet.'
